suppress.notes: GHSA-cqj8-47ch-rvvq (CVE-2020-29582) affects Kotlin through 1.4.20, fixed in 1.4.21. kotlin-stdlib-common 1.9.10 arrives transitively through OkHttp -> Okio and is outside the affected range; the match comes from the broad NVD JetBrains Kotlin CPE. The version is pinned on purpose: this rule must stop matching the moment the artifact moves, so the assessment is redone rather than inherited.

CVE-2026-53914 affects org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin (build-cache metadata deserialization; vendor score 6.7). This Maven/Java service does not use that plugin and contains no Gradle build path; it only receives Kotlin runtime stdlib artifacts transitively through OpenTelemetry -> OkHttp. Dependency-Check issue #8749 records the same stdlib match as a broad-CPE false positive. Enumeration derived from the Dependency-Check JSON report of the sec-depcheck-1 run (2026-09-02): the tree contains kotlin-stdlib, kotlin-stdlib-common and kotlin-stdlib-jdk7 only. Versions pinned on purpose (see the CVE-2020-29582 rule). Remove once NVD narrows the CPE or the transitive stdlib moves past the flagged coordinates.
